payload_shape.record: the final result record with exactly the registered JSON pointers removed

canonicalization.object_keys: recursively sort by ECMAScript default Array.prototype.sort UTF-16 code-unit order
canonicalization.serialization: JSON.stringify with no replacer and no whitespace, then append exactly one LF
canonicalization.numbers: finite JSON numbers only; reject negative zero and non-finite values before serialization
canonicalization.digest: SHA-256 of the serialized UTF-8 bytes

rules: Before unblinding, every non-removed field required by the result schema is present and immutable; every removed field is absent.
experiment_id, run_id, and blinded_candidate_id are opaque random identifiers with no case-arm or variant mnemonic.

The payload hash and freeze timestamp live in a separate controller-owned receipt and are not fields inside the hashed payload; record_validation_receipt_sha256 is also populated only after the final detached validation.
After the arm-key join, populate every removed field required by the final schema without changing any retained field.

Reconstruct the anonymous payload from the final record by removing exactly these pointers, wrapping it in payload_shape, canonicalizing it, and requiring byte-for-byte and SHA-256 equality with the frozen payload.
Reject a record containing any schema-unknown field or any additional field whose treatment is not defined by this contract.
